notion.note:
[Map / Rendering / UI] — Owner: drg amtd — draft review owner; owner review pending — Source: 27-Scenario-Library-Campaigns.md — Matched: 8. MapPlaceholderPanelHost binds the projected picture and routes symbol clicks through its presentation feed. Its existing atlas choice is: ; Requirements: Game-Requirements/requirements/20-Command-And-Control-UI.md; Game-Requirements/drafts/2026-09-05-military-tactical-symbology.m ---

Status: Draft

Owner: drg amtd — draft review owner; owner review pending

Related Linear Milestone: Combat UX M0 / S122–S127 — source-backed design reconciliation; H5 remains gated

Last updated: 2026-09-30

--- ## Overview The tactical map is a presentation client over the headless simulation. It renders registered friendly units, log-derived contacts, alive/dead state, optional kinematic poses, and plotted courses through MapPictureBridge and immutable projection rows. Presentation boundaries are ADR-010 §2–3, ADR-007, and ADR-001. Evidence scope: The 2026-09-30 source inspection cited a local checkout at HEAD 4190fb1b49cd15775b6b995b7c245d73828cd7a2, with existing working-tree changes. As of 2026-11-20 that SHA is not on origin (absent from a fetched clone and from GitHub), and uncommitted working-tree changes cannot be pinned. Published main SHAs: last main tip at the time of the inspection, [1902dc12](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/1902dc1299678ea17f75014406fd9c616e5576bd) (2026-09-27, 2:40 PM CDT, #681); current main [99a4d6e4](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/99a4d6e4be82dcf1bbce372caa47abef150f2b9b) (2026-11-17, 7:16 PM CT). The source contracts below were not GitHub blob or commit links, so those paths were left as-is after confirming they exist at [1902dc12](https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/1902dc1299678ea17f75014406fd9c616e5576bd). Refreshed against main 1902dc12 because 4190fb1b was never pushed (ruling: Decision, 2026-11-20). This is not a claim about current main or owner Play Mode acceptance. GitNexus was queried with the absolute repository path and corroborated against source because DRG-323/324 record index/overload limitations. Existing delivery includes the placeholder map host, map bridge/binder, selection controller, course projection, glyph/atlas fallback seams, and globe status host code. Full globe interaction, complete tactical symbology, and H5 content loading remain separately scoped delivery or design work; host presence does not establish product completeness. ## Player Fantasy The player reads a theater picture, selects a friendly force or contact, inspects why events occurred, and issues deliberate commands. The map must make unavailable positional evidence distinguishable from a real tracked position. Selecting or inspecting an item changes presentation context without changing authoritative simulation state. ## Detailed Rules 1. MapPictureBridge collects OOB membership from the target registry, alive state and optional kinematic poses from ISimWorldSnapshot, and contact rows from the decision-log contact projection. Rendering does not write the world or decision log. 2. Placement precedence is exact: a complete normalized X/Y pair wins; otherwise a complete latitude/longitude pair projects onto the Baltic canvas; otherwise use deterministic hash placement and set HasAuthoritativePose to false. With normalized coordinates, supplied geographic coordinates are retained when both exist; otherwise derive Baltic geographic coordinates. Normalized coordinates are not clamped by this projection. 3. Friendly and contact rows are sorted by affiliation and then symbol ID using ordinal comparison. The current basic contact path renders contacts as Hostile; it does not implement the full future affiliation/classification symbology matrix. 4. MapPanelBinder marks non-authoritative placements as unknown-pose, applies selection styling, adds stale/ghost presentation for degraded hostile contacts, and frozen styling for denied comms. These styles are presentation effects, not additional sensor truth. 5. Selecting a friendly unit clears contact selection. Selecting a hostile contact clears the friendly selection and graph highlights from the previous unit. CombatInspection is separate from the unit selection used for player commands. 6. Plotted courses omit destroyed units, absent waypoint lists, and paths with fewer than two vertices. The current pose or hash fallback is prepended unless it already matches the first waypoint. 7. Interpolation only blends matching, non-destroyed symbols with authoritative previous and current poses. New, unknown-pose, or destroyed symbols use the current row. Frame interpolation never enters authoritative clocks or order logs. 8. MapPlaceholderPanelHost binds the projected picture and routes symbol clicks through its presentation feed. Its existing atlas choice is: unavailable catalog when frames are disabled; successfully loaded local manifest catalog when preferred; otherwise the default atlas catalog. This bounded fallback does not prove the broader H5 loader or LIB-05 failure-isolation requirement is implemented. 9. Authority-changing map actions use the approved command façade under ADR-010. Camera, layout, selection, and inspection are presentation actions. Full military/civilian symbology profiles remain proposed in the two 2026-09-05 requirement drafts. ## Formulas Baltic canvas projection (existing code): ```txt x = clamp01((longitude - 24.0) / 1.5) y = clamp01((latitude - 59.5) / 1.0) latitude = 59.5 + normalizedY * 1.0 longitude = 24.0 + normalizedX * 1.5 ``` Only the latitude/longitude-to-canvas path clamps. The inverse and normalized-pose path do not add a clamp. Placeholder placement (existing code): hash the string seed:ID with DeterministicHash.OrdinalHash. For friendly units use layoutSeed; for contacts use layoutSeed + 17. Take the low 16 bits for hx and the next 16 bits for hy. ```txt x = (hx / 65535) * 0.75 + 0.1 y = (hy / 65535) * 0.75 + 0.1 ``` This places fallback markers in the interior of the canvas; it is a layout convention, not estimated geography. Presentation interpolation: for 0 ≤ t \< 1, blend each eligible coordinate as a + (b - a) \* t; negative t becomes zero, and t ≥ 1 returns current rows. Geographic values blend only when both endpoints provide them. Course first-vertex equality uses absolute X and Y differences below 1e-5. ## Edge Cases - Missing or incomplete coordinate pairs fall through the precedence rule rather than fabricating a partial authoritative pose. - Out-of-box geographic coordinates clamp to the Baltic canvas edge while retaining the original geographic values. Out-of-range normalized values are retained by MapPictureProjection; upstream validation is a separate responsibility. - Missing atlas frames must resolve through the existing glyph fallback seam. H5 will define asset delay, corruption, version mismatch, timeout/cancellation, visible diagnostics, and measured budgets for its chosen local pilot before delivery. - Ghost rows are unselected and carry ghost IDs; they must not masquerade as new authoritative contacts. - Destroyed units retain destroyed-symbol presentation and do not emit plotted courses or interpolate motion. - Inspection history may lack pose evidence. Display unavailable evidence explicitly instead of substituting a later/current pose. - Empty OOB/contact inputs produce an empty picture. Null required bridge inputs are rejected. Finite-coordinate validation is not introduced by this design refresh. ## Dependencies Current source contracts: - src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Bridge/MapPictureBridge.cs - src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/MapPictureProjection.cs - src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/MapPanelBinder.cs - src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/MapSymbolPresentationLerp.cs - src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Presentation/C2PresentationController.cs - unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/MapPlaceholderPanelHost.cs - unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/GlobeMapProductHost.cs — present in the pre-existing dirty working tree; no integrated-main equivalence claimed. Normative architecture: docs/architecture/adr-010-headless-first-command-driven-ui.md, docs/architecture/adr-007-c2-map-presentation.md, docs/architecture/adr-001-sim-assembly-boundary.md. Requirements: Game-Requirements/requirements/20-Command-And-Control-UI.md; Game-Requirements/drafts/2026-09-05-military-tactical-symbology.md; Game-Requirements/drafts/2026-09-05-civilian-gameplay-symbology.md; proposed LIB-05 in Game-Requirements/drafts/27-Scenario-Library-Campaigns.md. Related design: Core Simulation Design and Weapons & Engagement Resolution. ## Tuning Knobs layoutSeed controls placeholder layout only. ScenarioCommsDisplaySettings supplies ghost offsets and lag labels. The host frame-enable flag, manifest preference, and manifest path select the current atlas availability path. Presentation interpolation t belongs to the frame clock. Baltic box constants describe the current demo projection; making arbitrary theater bounds data-driven is a future design decision. H5 compatibility versions, timeout/cancellation policy, content class, diagnostic wording, and performance budgets remain explicit pilot decisions. Neither a 5k-symbol/60 FPS product target nor full globe fidelity is asserted by this page. ## Acceptance Criteria Existing contracts to preserve, validated here by source inspection rather than a new test run: - Same seed and IDs give stable fallback placement and ordering; a complete pose replaces fallback and sets the authoritative flag. Evidence: src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Projection/MapPictureProjectionTests.cs and src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter.Tests/Bridge/MapPictureBridgeTests.cs. - Unknown pose, selection, comms ghost/frozen styling, and atlas fallback remain observable. linear.title: DRG-231 follow-up: [SYM-MIL] preserve naval type icon + MIL SIDC through map/Cesium symbology projection; immutable SymbolKeyRegistry.All
linear.description:
## Context

Deferred code-review findings on [PR #694](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/694>) (S126 MIL-only symbology subset — canonical keys, profile switch, disclaimer; <issue id="a657c027-6658-4623-97d1-eba4b527acb2" label="DRG-231" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-231/sym-mil-01-military-tactical-symbology-ntds-app-6-mil-std-2525" /> SYM-MIL-01).

## Findings

1. `SymbologyProjection.cs:63` **— combatant vs unknown look identical in projected map rows.** The naval type icon is not preserved when rows are projected, so a classified combatant and an unknown contact render the same glyph.
2. **Cesium path re-parses MIL SIDC into the legacy ground glyph.** `CesiumBillboardProjection` takes the military SIDC produced by the MIL profile and re-parses it into the legacy ground glyph, losing domain/type on the globe.
3. `SymbolKeyRegistry.All` **exposes a castable array.** Callers can cast the exposed collection back to an array and mutate the registry. Expose `Array.AsReadOnly(...)` / an immutable collection instead.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #694)

`SymbologyProjection.Apply` has no non-test caller yet, so none of these affect a shipped surface today. **Must be done before the map consumes the MIL profile.**

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Projected map rows preserve the naval/domain type icon; a combatant and an unknown contact of the same platform type produce distinguishable symbols (test covers both).
* `CesiumBillboardProjection` consumes the MIL SIDC / canonical key directly (no re-parse into the legacy ground glyph); test proves a naval MIL SIDC stays naval on the Cesium path.
* `SymbolKeyRegistry.All` returns a read-only/immutable collection; a test proves it cannot be cast to a mutable array and mutated.
* Observer-safe unknown fallback (MIL-AC) unchanged; ReplayGolden / Baltic v2 hashes untouched; projection stays presentation-only.

Delivery: [DRG-231](https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-231). Linear owns delivery status; this page owns the draft design and acceptance criteria. Local draft mirror: Game-Requirements/drafts/2026-09-05-military-tactical-symbology.md (uncommitted working copy, not a landed Git source). Linked from REQ-20 and the local Game Requirements index. Paired profile: [SYM-CIV-01](https://app.notion.com/p/3d2f7cb4e4df81a68f32f174cabcd48d). ## Requirement — SYM-MIL-01 Project Aegis shall provide a selectable Military Tactical symbology profile for U.S. Navy surface ships and the other supported unit/contact domains. The profile shall use documented NTDS naval display conventions and an explicitly versioned mapping to NATO APP-6 and U.S. MIL-STD-2525, informed by the CMANO/CMO tactical-display reference experience. ## Standards and reference interpretation CMO's official UI addendum names its military symbol option NTDS + NATO APP-6, alongside a Stylized option. MIL-STD-2525 is the U.S. joint military symbology standard; APP-6 is the NATO standard family. These names must not be treated as interchangeable or as evidence that CMO implements every provision of MIL-STD-2525. The supplied NTIS link identifies the 2007 Common Navy Warfighting Display Symbology Implementation Guide (ADA484484), not the standard itself. Its abstract describes maritime implementation of MIL-STD-2525 and additional Navy modifiers from NTDS/SSDS. Use this as supporting naval guidance; document deviations from the selected standard. DLA lists MIL-STD-2525 Revision E Change 1, dated 2025-03-02. Proposed implementation baseline: that revision for the U.S. mapping; the exact APP-6 edition and NTDS subset must be pinned in the mapping specification before artwork implementation. This is a documented subset requirement, not a claim of formal standards certification. ## Acceptance criteria - MIL-AC-01: Map options expose a clearly named Military Tactical profile and an in-game legend identifying its selected standards editions and any custom deviations. - MIL-AC-02: A versioned symbol mapping manifest records semantic key, domain, affiliation, known platform category, frame/icon/modifiers, source edition or guide section, and fallback for every supported symbol. Missing entries use a documented generic unknown symbol. - MIL-AC-03: The naval test atlas covers at least carrier, destroyer, cruiser, frigate, amphibious, support/auxiliary, and unknown surface vessel categories when known to the observer. Any category unsupported by the chosen standard has an explicit generic fallback; symbols must not invent class-level identification. - MIL-AC-04: Friendly, hostile, neutral, and unknown tracks are distinguishable by shape/frame and text/legend, not color alone. A U.S. Navy platform's nationality does not automatically make it friendly; displayed affiliation follows the observer's projected knowledge. - MIL-AC-05: Domain, affiliation, heading when known, selection, and observed contact quality/status remain readable at supported zoom/UI scales. Selection and command/outcome overlays must not overwrite or contradict symbol identity. Unobserved damage and platform type stay undisclosed. - MIL-AC-06: Map, OOB, and detail views identify the same selected entity, including contact-to-unit selection transitions. Switching to/from the civilian profile preserves selection, camera position, simulation time, and active orders. - MIL-AC-07: Headless mapping/unknown-fallback tests plus a Unity visual atlas review prove conformance to the declared subset and document any deviations. Asset provenance is retained; CMANO/CMO are behavior references, not a source of copied proprietary artwork. ## Sources - [CMO official UI addendum — Map Symbols](https://command.matrixgames.com/?page_id=2697) - [DLA official MIL-STD-2525 record](https://quicksearch.dla.mil/qsDocDetails.aspx?ident_number=114934) - [NTIS / Naval Surface Warfare Center naval symbology guide, ADA484484](https://ntrl.ntis.gov/NTRL/dashboard/searchResults/titleDetail/ADA484484.xhtml) - [User-supplied NTDS discussion — contextual only, not a normative standard](https://forum.finescale.com/t/navy-command-symbols/132729) ## Boundaries and delivery Status: Draft requirement, recorded 2026-09-05 at the user's request. Implementation is not started or scheduled. This addition does not mark existing map symbology complete or reopen a release milestone. Related requirements: REQ-20 / CMD-06 (map picture), CMD-07 (selection sync), CMD-12 (accessibility), CMD-13 (APP-6/LOD), CMD-28 (map options), CMD-29 (contact knowledge), and CMD-30 (tactical overlays). Architecture: presentation reads existing observer-side projections and preserves ADR-010 §§2–3, ADR-007, and ADR-001. Changing a symbol profile must not change simulation state, orders, ROE, ownership, visibility, contact knowledge, or replay hashes. Missing or uncertain information must remain missing or uncertain. Verification: headless mapping/semantic tests first, then Unity Game view UAT and retained screenshots. Verify selection and contact provenance in both profiles, including unknown, stale/lost, and degraded-comms tracks.

Code-base review (drgaciw/cmano-clone @ main, 2026-10-07) Present: Sim/Engage (DLZ, magazine ledger, domain validators incl. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), Sim/Sensors (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, ScenarioJamResolver, datalink picture merger), Sim/Logistics (air/boat ops FSMs, FuelLedger, ScenarioSeaState), Delegation/Comms (CommsState, CommsOrderDelay, track staleness, spoof timeline), Delegation/EmconPosture, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349). Gaps found by code search (0 non-test hits): weather/cloud layers in sensors, thermocline/convergence zones/sonar propagation, decoys/chaff/flares/countermeasures, sonobuoys, terrain/radar-horizon LOS (1 hit only), torpedo modeling (1 hit), comms jamming tied to Sim authority, damage control/flooding (minimal), campaign layer, multiplayer/lockstep (only ADR stage). Linear search found no issues for weather, acoustic, sonar, countermeasure, torpedo, or terrain. ## 3. New requirements Each must stay inside Sim authority, be deterministic (seeded, same-build replayable), and expose facts to presentation via existing projections. Presentation never computes outcomes. ### ENV — Environment - ENV-01 Weather & cloud-layer model. Scenario weather (cloud layers with base/top altitude and density, precipitation, wind, visibility, time-of-day lighting) as authored scenario data. AC: IR/visual detection gets a deterministic modifier per layer; a unit's altitude relative to layers is queryable; the editor validates layer ordering. - ENV-02 Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick. - ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state. ### ASW — Undersea warfare - ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. Simplified passive/active sonar equation (source level, transmission loss, noise, DI, DT) with layer depth, surface duct, convergence zones, and bottom bounce. AC: deterministic SNR → detection probability; shallow-water/under-ice reverberation scaled by sonar generation and frequency. - ASW-02 Platform acoustic signatures. Speed-dependent radiated noise, cavitation, and own-ship noise penalty on hull sonar. AC: catalog fields plus validation rules; sprint-and-drift behavior emerges. - ASW-03 Sonobuoys & dipping sonar. Expendable sensor fields with lifetime, depth setting, and datalink to parent. AC: the sonobuoy inventory uses MagazineLedger; buoy contacts merge through the datalink picture. - ASW-04 Torpedo engagement model. Torpedo as a simulated weapon entity (wire-guided, acoustic homing, run-to-enable, seeker cone, evasion). AC: resolves through IEngagementResolver; abort codes are added to EngagementAbortReasonCodes. - ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed CommsOrderDelay. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI. - OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on DetectionWorldHash. Dependency: DRG-325/329. ## 4. Suggested sequencing 1. ENV-02, EW-01, C3-01 (low cost, existing hooks). 2. ASW-01/02/05 (new subsystem; spike first). 3. EW-02/03, DMG-01, HUM-01. 4. ASW-03/04, C3-02/03/04, ENV-01/03. 5. OPS-01..03; OPS-04 after H6. ## 5. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), Sim/Sensors (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, ScenarioJamResolver, datalink picture merger), Sim/Logistics (air/boat ops FSMs, FuelLedger, ScenarioSeaState), Delegation/Comms (CommsState, CommsOrderDelay, track staleness, spoof timeline), Delegation/EmconPosture, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349). Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: resolves through IEngagementResolver; abort codes are added to EngagementAbortReasonCodes. - ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed CommsOrderDelay. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI. - OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on DetectionWorldHash. Dependency: DRG-325/329. ## 4. Suggested sequencing 1. ENV-02, EW-01, C3-01 (low cost, existing hooks). 2. ASW-01/02/05 (new subsystem; spike first). 3. EW-02/03, DMG-01, HUM-01. 4. ASW-03/04, C3-02/03/04, ENV-01/03. 5. OPS-01..03; OPS-04 after H6. ## 5. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), Sim/Sensors (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, ScenarioJamResolver, datalink picture merger), Sim/Logistics (air/boat ops FSMs, FuelLedger, ScenarioSeaState), Delegation/Comms (CommsState, CommsOrderDelay, track staleness, spoof timeline), Delegation/EmconPosture, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349). AC: IR/visual detection gets a deterministic modifier per layer; a unit's altitude relative to layers is queryable; the editor validates layer ordering. - ENV-02 Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick. - ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state. ### ASW — Undersea warfare - ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. AC: deterministic SNR → detection probability; shallow-water/under-ice reverberation scaled by sonar generation and frequency. - ASW-02 Platform acoustic signatures. Speed-dependent radiated noise, cavitation, and own-ship noise penalty on hull sonar. AC: catalog fields plus validation rules; sprint-and-drift behavior emerges. - ASW-03 Sonobuoys & dipping sonar. AC: the sonobuoy inventory uses MagazineLedger; buoy contacts merge through the datalink picture. - ASW-04 Torpedo engagement model. AC: resolves through IEngagementResolver; abort codes are added to EngagementAbortReasonCodes. - ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed CommsOrderDelay. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI. - OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on DetectionWorldHash. Dependency: DRG-325/329. ## 4. Suggested sequencing 1. ENV-02, EW-01, C3-01 (low cost, existing hooks). 2. ASW-01/02/05 (new subsystem; spike first). 3. EW-02/03, DMG-01, HUM-01. 4. ASW-03/04, C3-02/03/04, ENV-01/03. 5. OPS-01..03; OPS-04 after H6. ## 5. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), Sim/Sensors (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, ScenarioJamResolver, datalink picture merger), Sim/Logistics (air/boat ops FSMs, FuelLedger, ScenarioSeaState), Delegation/Comms (CommsState, CommsOrderDelay, track staleness, spoof timeline), Delegation/EmconPosture, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349). Gaps found by code search (0 non-test hits): weather/cloud layers in sensors, thermocline/convergence zones/sonar propagation, decoys/chaff/flares/countermeasures, sonobuoys, terrain/radar-horizon LOS (1 hit only), torpedo modeling (1 hit), comms jamming tied to Sim authority, damage control/flooding (minimal), campaign layer, multiplayer/lockstep (only ADR stage). AC: IR/visual detection gets a deterministic modifier per layer; a unit's altitude relative to layers is queryable; the editor validates layer ordering. - ENV-02 Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick. - ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state. ### ASW — Undersea warfare - ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. Simplified passive/active sonar equation (source level, transmission loss, noise, DI, DT) with layer depth, surface duct, convergence zones, and bottom bounce. AC: deterministic SNR → detection probability; shallow-water/under-ice reverberation scaled by sonar generation and frequency. - ASW-02 Platform acoustic signatures. Speed-dependent radiated noise, cavitation, and own-ship noise penalty on hull sonar. AC: catalog fields plus validation rules; sprint-and-drift behavior emerges. - ASW-03 Sonobuoys & dipping sonar. Expendable sensor fields with lifetime, depth setting, and datalink to parent. AC: the sonobuoy inventory uses MagazineLedger; buoy contacts merge through the datalink picture. - ASW-04 Torpedo engagement model. AC: resolves through IEngagementResolver; abort codes are added to EngagementAbortReasonCodes. - ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed CommsOrderDelay. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI. - OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on DetectionWorldHash. Dependency: DRG-325/329. ## 4. Suggested sequencing 1. ENV-02, EW-01, C3-01 (low cost, existing hooks). 2. ASW-01/02/05 (new subsystem; spike first). 3. EW-02/03, DMG-01, HUM-01. 4. ASW-03/04, C3-02/03/04, ENV-01/03. 5. OPS-01..03; OPS-04 after H6. ## 5. linear.title: ECCM columns SQLite persistence (DRG-386 follow-up from #713)
linear.description:
Follow-up deferred from [PR #713](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/713>) (merged `3f5ae73f`; DRG-379/386/390), listed under "Follow-ups (not in this PR)".

`CatalogSensorBinding.RadarScanType`, `FrequencyAgile` and `RadarTechGeneration` are read and validated from catalog JSON (`CatalogRadarScanTypes.Validate`). But `CatalogJsonImporter.WriteSqlite`'s `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sensor` doesn't write them, and `SqliteCatalogReader` returns the defaults (empty / false / 0). So a SQLite-backed catalog gets no ECCM jam adjustment.

## Scope

* New extend-only migration under `assets/data/catalog/migrations` adding `radar_scan_type`, `frequency_agile`, `radar_tech_generation` to `sensor` (and to `sensor_quarantine` if quarantine rows round-trip).
* `CatalogJsonImporter` (sensor and quarantine inserts) writes the columns; `SqliteCatalogReader` maps them.
* Round-trip test: JSON → SQLite → reader equals the JSON reader result and passes `CatalogRadarScanTypes.Validate`.

## Constraints

* `CatalogWriteGate` **writes are hard-no.** `InsertStagingSensor` / `catalog_staging_sensor` and `CatalogQuarantinePromoter.InsertSensor` don't carry these columns. Extending the staged write path is out of scope and needs a CMANO Surface stamp plus owner GO as a separate item.
* Check whether `CatalogSnapshotHasher` output changes. Replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged; no ReplayGolden re-bless.

Design notes: `docs/engineering/los-eccm-offgrid.md`.

Clean-room: the features below are inspired by public descriptions only. No proprietary databases, scenarios, or code are reused. ## 1. Research summary (public sources) | Title | Relevant traits | Source | | --- | --- | --- | | Command: Modern Operations (CMO) | Joint air/naval/subsurface/ground/space/cyber; global 3D globe; EW and C4ISR | [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076160/Command\_Modern\_Operations/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076160/Command_Modern_Operations/) | | CMO comms disruption (ex-"Chains of War") | Units cut off from the comms grid lose direct control; on rejoin, contact merges are reported and no-info merges omitted. Realistic sub comms: subs below 40 m go off-grid and show last-reported position; ELF "bell-ringer" recall | [https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990](https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990) | | CMO aircrew/EW | Frequency-agile and AESA radars resist noise jamming and Doppler notching; beaming vs pulse-Doppler radars depends on crew skill; G-strain; detailed aircraft damage instead of one-hit kills | [https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990](https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990) | | CMO environment/sensors | 11 cloud profiles, flying below/within/above clouds; sonar reverberation from shallow water and ice scales with sonar tech level and frequency; passive bearing gates (4°–20°); heavy seas hurt small ships' unguided fire; NCTR (JEM, NBILST) | [https://command.matrixgames.com/?page\_id=2711](https://command.matrixgames.com/?page_id=2711) | | CMO comms jamming | Comms jamming moved from Professional Edition into CMO in v1.08, along with drone autonomy levels | [https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/18808439/](https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/18808439/) | | Harpoon series | Real-time with time compression; one to thousands of platforms; scenario editor; Harpoon ANW (2006) added human-vs-human play | [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harpoon\_(series)]() | | Sea Power | Dynamic time of day and weather; ECM; mission editor and global map; branching campaign; theater dynamic campaign (beta mid-2026); AI scripting for mission makers | [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286220](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286220) | | Cold Waters / sub sims | Serious sub sims are built on the passive sonar equation | [https://signallockapp.com/guides/submarine-simulator-history](https://signallockapp.com/guides/submarine-simulator-history) | ## 2. Code-base review (drgaciw/cmano-clone @ main, 2026-10-07) Present: Sim/Engage (DLZ, magazine ledger, domain validators incl. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), Sim/Sensors (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, ScenarioJamResolver, datalink picture merger), Sim/Logistics (air/boat ops FSMs, FuelLedger, ScenarioSeaState), Delegation/Comms (CommsState, CommsOrderDelay, track staleness, spoof timeline), Delegation/EmconPosture, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349). Gaps found by code search (0 non-test hits): weather/cloud layers in sensors, thermocline/convergence zones/sonar propagation, decoys/chaff/flares/countermeasures, sonobuoys, terrain/radar-horizon LOS (1 hit only), torpedo modeling (1 hit), comms jamming tied to Sim authority, damage control/flooding (minimal), campaign layer, multiplayer/lockstep (only ADR stage). Linear search found no issues for weather, acoustic, sonar, countermeasure, torpedo, or terrain. ## 3. New requirements Each must stay inside Sim authority, be deterministic (seeded, same-build replayable), and expose facts to presentation via existing projections. Presentation never computes outcomes. ### ENV — Environment - ENV-01 Weather & cloud-layer model. Scenario weather (cloud layers with base/top altitude and density, precipitation, wind, visibility, time-of-day lighting) as authored scenario data. AC: IR/visual detection gets a deterministic modifier per layer; a unit's altitude relative to layers is queryable; the editor validates layer ordering. - ENV-02 Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick. - ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state. ### ASW — Undersea warfare - ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. Simplified passive/active sonar equation (source level, transmission loss, noise, DI, DT) with layer depth, surface duct, convergence zones, and bottom bounce. AC: deterministic SNR → detection probability; shallow-water/under-ice reverberation scaled by sonar generation and frequency. - ASW-02 Platform acoustic signatures. Speed-dependent radiated noise, cavitation, and own-ship noise penalty on hull sonar. AC: catalog fields plus validation rules; sprint-and-drift behavior emerges. - ASW-03 Sonobuoys & dipping sonar. Expendable sensor fields with lifetime, depth setting, and datalink to parent. AC: the sonobuoy inventory uses MagazineLedger; buoy contacts merge through the datalink picture. - ASW-04 Torpedo engagement model. Torpedo as a simulated weapon entity (wire-guided, acoustic homing, run-to-enable, seeker cone, evasion). AC: resolves through IEngagementResolver; abort codes are added to EngagementAbortReasonCodes. - ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed CommsOrderDelay. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI. - OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on DetectionWorldHash. Dependency: DRG-325/329. ## 4. Suggested sequencing 1. ENV-02, EW-01, C3-01 (low cost, existing hooks). 2. ASW-01/02/05 (new subsystem; spike first). 3. EW-02/03, DMG-01, HUM-01. 4. ASW-03/04, C3-02/03/04, ENV-01/03. 5. OPS-01..03; OPS-04 after H6. ## 5. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick. - ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state. ### ASW — Undersea warfare - ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI. - OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). linear.title: Verify off-grid gating works when mvpEngagement=false (follow-up from #713)
linear.description:
Deferred from [PR #713](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/713>) (DRG-379/386/390), Codex P2 review thread PRRT_kwDOSqtCp86pyIb6: "Initialize off-grid state when engagement is disabled".

The original concern: with `commsGrid` transitions but `mvpEngagement: false`, `Session` was null, so the off-grid check always returned false and off-grid units still accepted orders. Off-grid membership is a comms rule, not an engagement feature. The gating has since moved out of `DelegationBridge.cs` into the orchestrator/command façade (`DelegationOrchestrator.CommsGrid`, `C2PlayerCommandBridge`), but that path has not been verified for `mvpEngagement=false`.

## Acceptance

* Add a verification test: scenario with `commsGrid` transitions, constructed with `mvpEngagement: false`; an off-grid unit's new direct orders, attack options and direct-control requests are refused with `FireAbortReason.OffGrid`, and back-on-grid restores them.
* If the test fails, fix it in the orchestrator/façade layer.
* **Must not touch the DelegationBridge hotpath** (`DelegationBridge.cs` / Tick); any `DelegationBridgeHost` or `SimulationSession` change needs a CMANO Surface stamp plus the owner's OK.
* Replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged; no ReplayGolden re-bless.

linear.title: CommsGrid registry engine position feed (DRG-390 follow-up from #713)
linear.description:
Follow-up deferred from [PR #713](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/713>) (merged `3f5ae73f`; DRG-379/386/390), listed under "Follow-ups (not in this PR)".

`CommsGridRegistry.ReportPosition(unitId, simTick, lat, lon)` exists and freezes reports while a unit is off grid, but only tests call it (`CommsGridRegistryTests`, `OffGridCommandFacadeTests`). In real sessions, `CommsGridProjection`'s last-reported position stays empty, so DRG-390's "UI shows the last-reported position" AC is only met in tests. `ObservedState` carries no positions, and `DelegationOrchestrator.Tick` advances the grid without unit kinematics.

## Scope

* After kinematics each tick, report unit positions to the registry in unit-id ordinal order.
* No RNG; scenarios without a `commsGrid` section are unaffected.

## Acceptance

* In a Baltic harness scenario with `commsGrid`, the last-reported position freezes at the off-grid tick and resumes after OnGrid.
* Replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged; no ReplayGolden re-bless.

## Hard-no

The likely wiring point is `SimulationSession.RunExecutingTick` (**hard-no**): needs owner GO plus a CMANO Surface stamp. `DelegationBridge.cs` / Tick stays zero-touch.

Design notes: `docs/engineering/los-eccm-offgrid.md`.

**Surface (CMANO 2026-10-14, main 254d2c96):** `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Orchestration/SimulationSession.cs` (only the post-kinematics position report in `RunExecutingTick`), `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Orchestration/OrchestratorOffGridTests.cs`, new `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Orchestration/SimulationSessionCommsGridPositionFeedTests.cs`. Read-only: `CommsGridRegistry.cs`, `CommsGridProjection.cs`, `DelegationOrchestrator.cs`, `docs/engineering/los-eccm-offgrid.md`. `DelegationBridge.cs` / Tick stays zero-touch.

linear.title: [C3-02] Rejoin reconciliation
linear.description:
On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log.

Source: Notion 'Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07'.

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

Research summary (public sources) | Title | Relevant traits | Source | | --- | --- | --- | | Command: Modern Operations (CMO) | Joint air/naval/subsurface/ground/space/cyber; global 3D globe; EW and C4ISR | [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076160/Command\_Modern\_Operations/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076160/Command_Modern_Operations/) | | CMO comms disruption (ex-"Chains of War") | Units cut off from the comms grid lose direct control; on rejoin, contact merges are reported and no-info merges omitted. Code-base review (drgaciw/cmano-clone @ main, 2026-10-07) Present: Sim/Engage (DLZ, magazine ledger, domain validators incl. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), Sim/Sensors (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, ScenarioJamResolver, datalink picture merger), Sim/Logistics (air/boat ops FSMs, FuelLedger, ScenarioSeaState), Delegation/Comms (CommsState, CommsOrderDelay, track staleness, spoof timeline), Delegation/EmconPosture, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349). Gaps found by code search (0 non-test hits): weather/cloud layers in sensors, thermocline/convergence zones/sonar propagation, decoys/chaff/flares/countermeasures, sonobuoys, terrain/radar-horizon LOS (1 hit only), torpedo modeling (1 hit), comms jamming tied to Sim authority, damage control/flooding (minimal), campaign layer, multiplayer/lockstep (only ADR stage). Linear search found no issues for weather, acoustic, sonar, countermeasure, torpedo, or terrain. ## 3. New requirements Each must stay inside Sim authority, be deterministic (seeded, same-build replayable), and expose facts to presentation via existing projections. Presentation never computes outcomes. ### ENV — Environment - ENV-01 Weather & cloud-layer model. Scenario weather (cloud layers with base/top altitude and density, precipitation, wind, visibility, time-of-day lighting) as authored scenario data. AC: IR/visual detection gets a deterministic modifier per layer; a unit's altitude relative to layers is queryable; the editor validates layer ordering. - ENV-02 Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick. - ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state. ### ASW — Undersea warfare - ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. Simplified passive/active sonar equation (source level, transmission loss, noise, DI, DT) with layer depth, surface duct, convergence zones, and bottom bounce. AC: deterministic SNR → detection probability; shallow-water/under-ice reverberation scaled by sonar generation and frequency. - ASW-02 Platform acoustic signatures. Speed-dependent radiated noise, cavitation, and own-ship noise penalty on hull sonar. AC: catalog fields plus validation rules; sprint-and-drift behavior emerges. - ASW-03 Sonobuoys & dipping sonar. Expendable sensor fields with lifetime, depth setting, and datalink to parent. AC: the sonobuoy inventory uses MagazineLedger; buoy contacts merge through the datalink picture. - ASW-04 Torpedo engagement model. Torpedo as a simulated weapon entity (wire-guided, acoustic homing, run-to-enable, seeker cone, evasion). AC: resolves through IEngagementResolver; abort codes are added to EngagementAbortReasonCodes. - ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed CommsOrderDelay. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI. - OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on DetectionWorldHash. Dependency: DRG-325/329. ## 4. Suggested sequencing 1. ENV-02, EW-01, C3-01 (low cost, existing hooks). 2. ASW-01/02/05 (new subsystem; spike first). 3. EW-02/03, DMG-01, HUM-01. 4. ASW-03/04, C3-02/03/04, ENV-01/03. 5. OPS-01..03; OPS-04 after H6. ## 5. linear.title: [C3-04] Comms jamming
linear.description:
Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed `CommsOrderDelay`. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed.

Source: Notion 'Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07'.

notion.title: Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07
notion.note: [Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07] — Status: Draft | Status: Draft / owner-review-pending. Clean-room: the features below are inspired by public descriptions only. No proprietary databases, scenarios, or code are reused. ## 1. Research summary (public sources) | Title | Relevant traits | Source | | --- | --- | --- | | Command: Modern Operations (CMO) | Joint air/naval/subsurface/ground/space/cyber; global 3D globe; EW and C4ISR | [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076160/Command\_Modern\_Operations/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076160/Command_Modern_Operations/) | | CMO comms disruption (ex-"Chains of War") | Units cut off from the comms grid lose direct control; on rejoin, contact merges are reported and no-info merges omitted. Realistic sub comms: subs below 40 m go off-grid and show last-reported position; ELF "bell-ringer" recall | [https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990](https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990) | | CMO aircrew/EW | Frequency-agile and AESA radars resist noise jamming and Doppler notching; beaming vs pulse-Doppler radars depends on crew skill; G-strain; detailed aircraft damage instead of one-hit kills | [https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990](https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990) | | CMO environment/sensors | 11 cloud profiles, flying below/within/above clouds; sonar reverberation from shallow water and ice scales with sonar tech level and frequency; passive bearing gates (4°–20°); heavy seas hurt small ships' unguided fire; NCTR (JEM, NBILST) | [https://command.matrixgames.com/?page\_id=2711](https://command.matrixgames.com/?page_id=2711) | | CMO comms jamming | Comms jamming moved from Professional Edition into CMO in v1.08, along with drone autonomy levels | [https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/18808439/](https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/18808439/) | | Harpoon series | Real-time with time compression; one to thousands of platforms; scenario editor; Harpoon ANW (2006) added human-vs-human play | [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harpoon\_(series)]() | | Sea Power | Dynamic time of day and weather; ECM; mission editor and global map; branching campaign; theater dynamic campaign (beta mid-2026); AI scripting for mission makers | [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286220](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286220) | | Cold Waters / sub sims | Serious sub sims are built on the passive sonar equation | [https://signallockapp.com/guides/submarine-simulator-history](https://signallockapp.com/guides/submarine-simulator-history) | ## 2. Code-base review (drgaciw/cmano-clone @ main, 2026-10-07) Present: Sim/Engage (DLZ, magazine ledger, domain validators incl. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), Sim/Sensors (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, ScenarioJamResolver, datalink picture merger), Sim/Logistics (air/boat ops FSMs, FuelLedger, ScenarioSeaState), Delegation/Comms (CommsState, CommsOrderDelay, track staleness, spoof timeline), Delegation/EmconPosture, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349). Gaps found by code search (0 non-test hits): weather/cloud layers in sensors, thermocline/convergence zones/sonar propagation, decoys/chaff/flares/countermeasures, sonobuoys, terrain/radar-horizon LOS (1 hit only), torpedo modeling (1 hit), comms jamming tied to Sim authority, damage control/flooding (minimal), campaign layer, multiplayer/lockstep (only ADR stage). Linear search found no issues for weather, acoustic, sonar, countermeasure, torpedo, or terrain. ## 3. New requirements Each must stay inside Sim authority, be deterministic (seeded, same-build replayable), and expose facts to presentation via existing projections. Presentation never computes outcomes. ### ENV — Environment - ENV-01 Weather & cloud-layer model. Scenario weather (cloud layers with base/top altitude and density, precipitation, wind, visibility, time-of-day lighting) as authored scenario data. AC: IR/visual detection gets a deterministic modifier per layer; a unit's altitude relative to layers is queryable; the editor validates layer ordering. - ENV-02 Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick. - ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state. ### ASW — Undersea warfare - ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. Simplified passive/active sonar equation (source level, transmission loss, noise, DI, DT) with layer depth, surface duct, convergence zones, and bottom bounce. AC: deterministic SNR → detection probability; shallow-water/under-ice reverberation scaled by sonar generation and frequency. - ASW-02 Platform acoustic signatures. Speed-dependent radiated noise, cavitation, and own-ship noise penalty on hull sonar. AC: catalog fields plus validation rules; sprint-and-drift behavior emerges. - ASW-03 Sonobuoys & dipping sonar. Expendable sensor fields with lifetime, depth setting, and datalink to parent. AC: the sonobuoy inventory uses MagazineLedger; buoy contacts merge through the datalink picture. - ASW-04 Torpedo engagement model. Torpedo as a simulated weapon entity (wire-guided, acoustic homing, run-to-enable, seeker cone, evasion). AC: resolves through IEngagementResolver; abort codes are added to EngagementAbortReasonCodes. - ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed CommsOrderDelay. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI. - OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on DetectionWorldHash. Dependency: DRG-325/329. ## 4. Suggested sequencing 1. ENV-02, EW-01, C3-01 (low cost, existing hooks). 2. ASW-01/02/05 (new subsystem; spike first). 3. EW-02/03, DMG-01, HUM-01. 4. ASW-03/04, C3-02/03/04, ENV-01/03. 5. OPS-01..03; OPS-04 after H6. ## 5.
