notion.title: Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07
notion.note: [Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07] — Status: Draft | Status: Draft / owner-review-pending. Clean-room: the features below are inspired by public descriptions only. — Matched: | DMG-02 | DRG-395 | Backlog | ; - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. --- Status: Draft / owner-review-pending. Clean-room: the features below are inspired by public descriptions only. No proprietary databases, scenarios, or code are reused. ## 1. Research summary (public sources) | Title | Relevant traits | Source | | --- | --- | --- | | Command: Modern Operations (CMO) | Joint air/naval/subsurface/ground/space/cyber; global 3D globe; EW and C4ISR | [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076160/Command\_Modern\_Operations/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076160/Command_Modern_Operations/) | | CMO comms disruption (ex-"Chains of War") | Units cut off from the comms grid lose direct control; on rejoin, contact merges are reported and no-info merges omitted. Realistic sub comms: subs below 40 m go off-grid and show last-reported position; ELF "bell-ringer" recall | [https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990](https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990) | | CMO aircrew/EW | Frequency-agile and AESA radars resist noise jamming and Doppler notching; beaming vs pulse-Doppler radars depends on crew skill; G-strain; detailed aircraft damage instead of one-hit kills | [https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990](https://command.matrixgames.com/?p=4990) | | CMO environment/sensors | 11 cloud profiles, flying below/within/above clouds; sonar reverberation from shallow water and ice scales with sonar tech level and frequency; passive bearing gates (4°–20°); heavy seas hurt small ships' unguided fire; NCTR (JEM, NBILST) | [https://command.matrixgames.com/?page\_id=2711](https://command.matrixgames.com/?page_id=2711) | | CMO comms jamming | Comms jamming moved from Professional Edition into CMO in v1.08, along with drone autonomy levels | [https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/18808439/](https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/18808439/) | | Harpoon series | Real-time with time compression; one to thousands of platforms; scenario editor; Harpoon ANW (2006) added human-vs-human play | [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harpoon\_(series)]() | | Sea Power | Dynamic time of day and weather; ECM; mission editor and global map; branching campaign; theater dynamic campaign (beta mid-2026); AI scripting for mission makers | [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286220](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286220) | | Cold Waters / sub sims | Serious sub sims are built on the passive sonar equation | [https://signallockapp.com/guides/submarine-simulator-history](https://signallockapp.com/guides/submarine-simulator-history) | ## 2. Code-base review (drgaciw/cmano-clone @ main, 2026-10-07) Present: Sim/Engage (DLZ, magazine ledger, domain validators incl. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), Sim/Sensors (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, ScenarioJamResolver, datalink picture merger), Sim/Logistics (air/boat ops FSMs, FuelLedger, ScenarioSeaState), Delegation/Comms (CommsState, CommsOrderDelay, track staleness, spoof timeline), Delegation/EmconPosture, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349). Gaps found by code search (0 non-test hits): weather/cloud layers in sensors, thermocline/convergence zones/sonar propagation, decoys/chaff/flares/countermeasures, sonobuoys, terrain/radar-horizon LOS (1 hit only), torpedo modeling (1 hit), comms jamming tied to Sim authority, damage control/flooding (minimal), campaign layer, multiplayer/lockstep (only ADR stage). Linear search found no issues for weather, acoustic, sonar, countermeasure, torpedo, or terrain. ## 3. New requirements Each must stay inside Sim authority, be deterministic (seeded, same-build replayable), and expose facts to presentation via existing projections. Presentation never computes outcomes. ### ENV — Environment - ENV-01 Weather & cloud-layer model. Scenario weather (cloud layers with base/top altitude and density, precipitation, wind, visibility, time-of-day lighting) as authored scenario data. AC: IR/visual detection gets a deterministic modifier per layer; a unit's altitude relative to layers is queryable; the editor validates layer ordering. - ENV-02 Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick. - ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state. ### ASW — Undersea warfare - ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. Simplified passive/active sonar equation (source level, transmission loss, noise, DI, DT) with layer depth, surface duct, convergence zones, and bottom bounce. AC: deterministic SNR → detection probability; shallow-water/under-ice reverberation scaled by sonar generation and frequency. - ASW-02 Platform acoustic signatures. Speed-dependent radiated noise, cavitation, and own-ship noise penalty on hull sonar. AC: catalog fields plus validation rules; sprint-and-drift behavior emerges. - ASW-03 Sonobuoys & dipping sonar. Expendable sensor fields with lifetime, depth setting, and datalink to parent. AC: the sonobuoy inventory uses MagazineLedger; buoy contacts merge through the datalink picture. - ASW-04 Torpedo engagement model. Torpedo as a simulated weapon entity (wire-guided, acoustic homing, run-to-enable, seeker cone, evasion). AC: resolves through IEngagementResolver; abort codes are added to EngagementAbortReasonCodes. - ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed CommsOrderDelay. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. Linked scenarios with carry-over of losses and magazines plus story branches (Sea Power-style). AC: campaign manifest schema validated by the Mission Editor CLI. - OPS-03 Mission-maker AI scripting surface. A sandboxed, deterministic event/action scripting API over the existing trigger/event system. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on DetectionWorldHash. Dependency: DRG-325/329. ## 4. Suggested sequencing 1. ENV-02, EW-01, C3-01 (low cost, existing hooks). 2. ASW-01/02/05 (new subsystem; spike first). 3. EW-02/03, DMG-01, HUM-01. 4. ASW-03/04, C3-02/03/04, ENV-01/03. 5. OPS-01..03; OPS-04 after H6. ## 5. Subsurface/Mine, Winchester/Bingo/Shotgun gates, hypersonic, CEC remote engage, BDA), Sim/Sensors (deterministic detection loop, IR/visual, PD contact sim, ScenarioJamResolver, datalink picture merger), Sim/Logistics (air/boat ops FSMs, FuelLedger, ScenarioSeaState), Delegation/Comms (CommsState, CommsOrderDelay, track staleness, spoof timeline), Delegation/EmconPosture, Mission Editor CLI, replay/save work (H6, DRG-325/329/349). New requirements Each must stay inside Sim authority, be deterministic (seeded, same-build replayable), and expose facts to presentation via existing projections. Presentation never computes outcomes. ### ENV — Environment - ENV-01 Weather & cloud-layer model. Scenario weather (cloud layers with base/top altitude and density, precipitation, wind, visibility, time-of-day lighting) as authored scenario data. AC: IR/visual detection gets a deterministic modifier per layer; a unit's altitude relative to layers is queryable; the editor validates layer ordering. - ENV-02 Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight. Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units. AC: the detection loop rejects a sensor-target pair blocked by the horizon or terrain, with a reason code; there is a performance budget per tick. - ENV-03 Sea-state effects. Extend ScenarioSeaState so it affects small-ship unguided fire accuracy, low-flyer radar clutter, and boat-ops launch/recovery. AC: effects are tabulated and covered by tests per sea state. ### ASW — Undersea warfare - ASW-01 Acoustic propagation model. Simplified passive/active sonar equation (source level, transmission loss, noise, DI, DT) with layer depth, surface duct, convergence zones, and bottom bounce. AC: deterministic SNR → detection probability; shallow-water/under-ice reverberation scaled by sonar generation and frequency. - ASW-02 Platform acoustic signatures. Speed-dependent radiated noise, cavitation, and own-ship noise penalty on hull sonar. AC: catalog fields plus validation rules; sprint-and-drift behavior emerges. - ASW-03 Sonobuoys & dipping sonar. Expendable sensor fields with lifetime, depth setting, and datalink to parent. AC: the sonobuoy inventory uses MagazineLedger; buoy contacts merge through the datalink picture. - ASW-04 Torpedo engagement model. Torpedo as a simulated weapon entity (wire-guided, acoustic homing, run-to-enable, seeker cone, evasion). AC: resolves through IEngagementResolver; abort codes are added to EngagementAbortReasonCodes. - ASW-05 Passive bearing-only tracking. Bearing gates by sonar generation; target masking; TMA solution quality grows over time. AC: contact projections show bearing-only vs fixed position with uncertainty. ### EW — Electronic warfare & countermeasures - EW-01 Radar ECCM attributes. Frequency-agile/PESA/AESA flags and tech generation in the catalog; jammer vs. radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver. AC: table-driven tests. - EW-02 Expendable countermeasures. Chaff, flares, towed and expendable decoys as magazine items with seeker-specific seduction probability. AC: engagement results record a countermeasure outcome; the BDA explanation shows the cause. - EW-03 Beaming / notching maneuver. Doctrine-triggered evasion versus pulse-Doppler radars, scaled by crew proficiency; ineffective against pulse-only radars. AC: deterministic outcome, explained in the engagement explanation. - EW-04 NCTR classification. JEM (frontal 15° arc) and imaging-based classification affect contact ID confidence. AC: contact lifecycle transitions include classification source. ### C3 — Communications authority - C3-01 Off-grid units in Sim. Promote Delegation/Comms state into a Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership. Off-grid units execute their last orders or doctrine and do not accept new direct orders. AC: the command façade rejects orders with an OffGrid reason; the UI shows the last-reported position. - C3-02 Rejoin reconciliation. On rejoin, merge the unit's contact picture into the side picture and emit a summary of informative merges only. AC: reported in the AAR/order log. - C3-03 Submarine comms depth & ELF recall. Subs below the comms depth go off-grid; an ELF recall order makes the sub attempt to come shallow, with a delay if threatened. AC: scenario toggle; deterministic test. - C3-04 Comms jamming. Area comms jammers degrade datalinks and command links and feed CommsOrderDelay. AC: CEC/mandatory-datalink pre-fire checks abort with a reason when the link is jammed. ### DMG — Damage & attrition - DMG-01 Component damage for aircraft. Replace one-hit kills with damage points plus component hits (engine, sensor, fuel leak) that drive RTB/Bingo. AC: hooks into CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate. - DMG-02 Ship damage control & flooding. Fires and flooding progress over time and are mitigated by crew quality; list and speed penalties. AC: deterministic progression; replay-stable. ### HUM — Crew / human factors - HUM-01 Crew proficiency. Five-level proficiency modifies OODA intervals, evasion, and DLZ personality. AC: a scenario-authored side/unit attribute. - HUM-02 G-strain & fatigue. Sustained hard maneuvering accumulates strain that degrades performance. AC: bounded state with tests. ### OPS — Operational layer - OPS-01 Time compression with safe-stop events. Harpoon/CMO-style compression that auto-drops to 1x on configurable events (new contact, weapon launch). AC: deterministic regardless of compression step. - OPS-02 Branching campaign. AC: the event debugger trace covers scripted actions; no direct Sim mutation outside the command façade. - OPS-04 Human-vs-human play (post-H6). Lockstep multiplayer gated on DRG-349 save/resume determinism. AC: a desync detector based on DetectionWorldHash. Dependency: DRG-325/329. ## 4. Suggested sequencing 1. linear.title: Per-category message-log notification policy (log / pause / map balloon / drop to 1x)
linear.description:
## Problem

The message log has no per-category notification policy. In CMO, each message type (new contact, weapon launch, weapon endgame, unit lost, fuel, etc.) can be set to: show in the log, raise a pop-up that pauses the sim, show a balloon on the map at the subject, and drop time compression to 1x. Without this, a player running at high time compression can miss a hostile launch or a lost unit until well after it happens. Aegis has pause and acceleration (<issue id="33bfdfcc-aeed-49b3-b9a5-e2dd6df86193" label="DRG-14" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause" />) and a message log (<issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" />), but nothing links log categories to attention or time-control behavior.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual, Game Options → Message Log: per message type, "Show on Message Log", "Raise Pop-Up" (pauses the game), "Show Balloon" (on the map at the subject's location), and "Timescale X1" (drop from acceleration to 1x). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/>)
* CMO manual §3.1.7: the log is split into categories that can be minimized or emphasized, so routine messages don't bury critical ones. Hovering a message highlights its subject on the map. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* Player feedback asks for exactly this per-type control, including keeping time running while still being notified. [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/](<https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" /> covers click → unit deep-link, and <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> covers sourcing combat lines from CombatEvent. Neither covers category policy or time-control escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageCategoryPolicy` projection maps each message category to {Log, Pause, Balloon, DropToRealTime}. Defaults are data-driven, not hardcoded.
* When a matching message arrives, the projection emits an attention intent. Pause and 1x requests go through the existing command/time façade as player-visible requests. The projection never calls sim internals directly, and the change does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath or SimulationSession.
* The UI binds only to the projection. A settings panel edits the policy, and balloon markers anchor to the message subject.
* Replay is deterministic: under AttachReplayViewer, policy-driven pauses are suppressed or reported but never change the order log.
* Tests cover the default mapping, a user override, and the no-op under replay.

Source: Projects Manager web research 2026-10-07

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** message log [DRG-402](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402>) (landed <pull-request id="f6dd5ef2-b75d-43d3-9c4a-eae5f822ddf6" label="feat(delegation): source combat message lines from the combat event log (DRG-402)" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featdelegation-source-combat-message-lines-from-the-combat-event-log-5616d5bf6eaf" />; docs <pull-request id="c5584753-2067-429d-b057-f84062cc92f4" label="docs(c2): document MessageLogProjection combat-event-log fence (DRG-402)" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsc2-document-messagelogprojection-combat-event-log-fence-drg-402-d7ed3133e75b" />, <pull-request id="e5631854-4dd2-4e42-b6b7-56a62cc09b21" label="docs(c2): document MessageLogProjection live-view fog entry point (DRG-402)" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsc2-document-messagelogprojection-live-view-fog-entry-point-drg-402-f4aadc39cb48" />), deep-link [DRG-268](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268>) (hold:owner-go), pause/acceleration [DRG-14](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause>), raw view/export [DRG-412](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-412>). ADR-010 command façade.
* **Dependencies:** <issue id="f805cf5f-1b4f-409e-ba15-a1690895618a" label="DRG-412" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-412/message-log-raw-text-view-and-deterministic-after-action-text-export" /> must land first per its CMANO Surface stamp (2026-10-29); coordinate with [DRG-268](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link>) and [DRG-412](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-412/message-log-raw-text-view-and-deterministic-after-action-text-export>) on the category taxonomy.
* **Fences (from rubric H3/H5):** headless projection first; source-fence test (no UnityEngine/MonoBehaviour/ApplyOrder/DecisionLog write/SimulationSession/DelegationBridge refs); replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged, no ReplayGolden re-bless; any visible UI change gets a named [DRG-208](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208>) Play Mode walk item (human gate).

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

First-package priority. Own the shared category-policy/attention-intent implementation. <issue id="867f8b51-af1a-4320-8edf-95b1ac4c07cd" label="DRG-398" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-398/ops-01-time-compression-with-safe-stop-events" /> owns accelerated-time integration/proof; <issue id="e6b8236e-036b-44a4-a4cf-aad1142d7815" label="DRG-269" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-269/n-irq-01-pending-approval-interrupt-force-1-and-dlz-countdown" /> owns pending-approval/DLZ behavior; reuse a single policy/coordinator.

Additional AC:

* Source alerts from the permitted live view; hidden information must not leak through sound, balloon, count or pause.
* Process each event identity once across refresh/reopen; replay scrubbing produces no live command.
* Deterministic simultaneous-intent precedence, with Pause above DropTo1x; dismissing one alert does not clear another unresolved pause reason.
* Routine coalescing retains counts and never suppresses a newly actionable approval.
* Verify safe-stop timing against actual accelerated pipeline steps; next-frame visual notification alone is insufficient.
* Reuse MessageLogBridge.ProjectLive and inspect C2ClockCommand; keep policy projection free of simulation mutation.

linear.title: Show doctrine/ROE/WRA inheritance source and effective value per unit, with reset-to-inherited
linear.description:
## Problem

Authority and ROE state is projected (<issue id="09fd8608-86ec-4243-888d-7dd0f126a8d2" label="DRG-182" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-182/project-command-authority-and-rules-of-engagement-state" />, <issue id="62f19a5c-38c2-44cb-ad50-c2e2ba23b291" label="DRG-209" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-209/slice-a-headless-authority-and-roe-projection" />), and WRA salvo-remaining shows on weapon chrome (<issue id="b052e2f4-59ae-43a4-850f-ae28460de62f" label="DRG-259" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-259/c2-02-wra-salvo-remaining-on-weapon-chrome" />). But the player cannot see *where* a unit's effective doctrine, ROE, or WRA value comes from (side, mission, group, or unit override), or reset an override back to inherited. In CMO this inheritance view is the main way a player finds out why a unit held fire or fired unexpectedly.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual §3.3.12: every doctrine option has an "inherited" setting. A unit follows its side's doctrine, or its mission's doctrine if assigned to one, and buttons reset it to the inherited default. Doctrine, EMCON, and WRA are separate tabs. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* CMO manual §6.3.8: side doctrine/ROE/WRA is set at the top level and "flows down to mission and then groups/units". The WRA tab lists every weapon the side uses. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/drop-down-menus/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="9cb22a1c-4d7a-499d-ba6d-44462898cedd" label="DRG-321" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-321/jev-vs3-roe-noul-facade-accept-coordinationcommandbridge" /> (ROE Noul + façade Accept) is about AI-assisted ROE suggestions, not showing inheritance. No issue covers per-level provenance or reset.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `DoctrineInheritanceProjection` gives, for each selected unit and each doctrine/ROE/WRA field: the effective value, the source level (Side/Mission/Group/Unit), and the overridden parent value if there is one.
* Reset-to-inherited is sent as a command through the command façade and recorded in the order log. It is never a UI-side state mutation.
* The unit panel shows an override marker and a source badge for each field, and the WRA rows show target-type × quantity × range using the existing <issue id="b052e2f4-59ae-43a4-850f-ae28460de62f" label="DRG-259" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-259/c2-02-wra-salvo-remaining-on-weapon-chrome" /> chrome.
* The engagement explanation (<issue id="4d622922-9423-4af4-aa9b-1aff30bf0146" label="DRG-168" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168/build-engagement-explanation-surface" />) can cite the doctrine source level when doctrine is the refusal reason.
* Tests cover inherited, mission-overridden, and unit-overridden fields, and the reset round-trip under replay.

Source: Projects Manager web research 2026-10-07

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** authority/ROE projections [DRG-182](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-182>), [DRG-209](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-209>); WRA chrome [DRG-259](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-259>); explanation [DRG-168](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168>) (C2 guide in <pull-request id="b80cd6c2-4f2a-4e86-b255-054abcbe5ec6" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#759" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsc2-reconcile-both-documentation-stacks-and-canonical-guides-e1c12e5af761" />); not a duplicate of [DRG-321](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-321>). ADR-010 command façade.
* **Dependencies:** <issue id="62f19a5c-38c2-44cb-ad50-c2e2ba23b291" label="DRG-209" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-209/slice-a-headless-authority-and-roe-projection" /> (Slice C must not edit Skills/ until it lands).
* **Fences (from rubric H3/H5):** headless projection first; source-fence test (no UnityEngine/MonoBehaviour/ApplyOrder/DecisionLog write/SimulationSession/DelegationBridge refs); replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged, no ReplayGolden re-bless; any visible UI change gets a named [DRG-208](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208>) Play Mode walk item (human gate).

linear.title: Per-category message-log notification policy (log / pause / map balloon / drop to 1x)
linear.description:
## Problem

The message log has no per-category notification policy. In CMO, each message type (new contact, weapon launch, weapon endgame, unit lost, fuel, etc.) can be set to: show in the log, raise a pop-up that pauses the sim, show a balloon on the map at the subject, and drop time compression to 1x. Without this, a player running at high time compression can miss a hostile launch or a lost unit until well after it happens. Aegis has pause and acceleration (<issue id="33bfdfcc-aeed-49b3-b9a5-e2dd6df86193" label="DRG-14" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause" />) and a message log (<issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" />), but nothing links log categories to attention or time-control behavior.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual, Game Options → Message Log: per message type, "Show on Message Log", "Raise Pop-Up" (pauses the game), "Show Balloon" (on the map at the subject's location), and "Timescale X1" (drop from acceleration to 1x). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/>)
* CMO manual §3.1.7: the log is split into categories that can be minimized or emphasized, so routine messages don't bury critical ones. Hovering a message highlights its subject on the map. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* Player feedback asks for exactly this per-type control, including keeping time running while still being notified. [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/](<https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" /> covers click → unit deep-link, and <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> covers sourcing combat lines from CombatEvent. Neither covers category policy or time-control escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageCategoryPolicy` projection maps each message category to {Log, Pause, Balloon, DropToRealTime}. Defaults are data-driven, not hardcoded.
* When a matching message arrives, the projection emits an attention intent. Pause and 1x requests go through the existing command/time façade as player-visible requests. The projection never calls sim internals directly, and the change does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath or SimulationSession.
* The UI binds only to the projection. A settings panel edits the policy, and balloon markers anchor to the message subject.
* Replay is deterministic: under AttachReplayViewer, policy-driven pauses are suppressed or reported but never change the order log.
* Tests cover the default mapping, a user override, and the no-op under replay.

Source: Projects Manager web research 2026-10-07

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** message log [DRG-402](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402>) (landed <pull-request id="f6dd5ef2-b75d-43d3-9c4a-eae5f822ddf6" label="feat(delegation): source combat message lines from the combat event log (DRG-402)" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featdelegation-source-combat-message-lines-from-the-combat-event-log-5616d5bf6eaf" />; docs <pull-request id="c5584753-2067-429d-b057-f84062cc92f4" label="docs(c2): document MessageLogProjection combat-event-log fence (DRG-402)" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsc2-document-messagelogprojection-combat-event-log-fence-drg-402-d7ed3133e75b" />, <pull-request id="e5631854-4dd2-4e42-b6b7-56a62cc09b21" label="docs(c2): document MessageLogProjection live-view fog entry point (DRG-402)" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsc2-document-messagelogprojection-live-view-fog-entry-point-drg-402-f4aadc39cb48" />), deep-link [DRG-268](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268>) (hold:owner-go), pause/acceleration [DRG-14](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause>), raw view/export [DRG-412](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-412>). * **Fences (from rubric H3/H5):** headless projection first; source-fence test (no UnityEngine/MonoBehaviour/ApplyOrder/DecisionLog write/SimulationSession/DelegationBridge refs); replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged, no ReplayGolden re-bless; any visible UI change gets a named [DRG-208](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208>) Play Mode walk item (human gate).

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Additional AC:

* Source alerts from the permitted live view; hidden information must not leak through sound, balloon, count or pause.
* Process each event identity once across refresh/reopen; replay scrubbing produces no live command.
* Deterministic simultaneous-intent precedence, with Pause above DropTo1x; dismissing one alert does not clear another unresolved pause reason.
* Routine coalescing retains counts and never suppresses a newly actionable approval.

linear.title: DRG-358 follow-up: [S124] wire commit strip/bark binders to live commit UI; coalesce double DROPPED bark; log fallback abort code
linear.description:
## Context

Deferred code-review findings on [PR #699](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/699>) (S124 pre-commit constraint/cost strip + refuse bark with ADR-010 fence; <issue id="c7df88ed-b9f5-41af-bb45-8d7c04e606f1" label="DRG-356" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-356/s124-01-w2-c2-01-pre-commit-constraint-cost-strip" /> S124-01, <issue id="0041b3f7-208a-4861-93f9-30d7fbe4ac0a" label="DRG-358" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-358/s124-03-w2-c2-04-refusedrop-bark-log-reason" /> S124-03).

## Findings

1. `CommitConstraintStripBinder` **/** `CommitRefusalBarkBinder` **are not wired to the live commit UI.** Both binders are headless/static; no Unity host binds them (suggested UXML names in the PR: `commit-strip-constraints`, `commit-strip-cost`, `commit-bark-line`).
2. `CommitRefusalBarkBinder.cs:170` **— two DROPPED barks for one refusal.** `SimulationSession` emits a `PolicyDenialRecord` *plus* a synthetic not-launched `EngagementRecord` for the same denied order, so the binder produces two DROPPED barks. Coalesce them into one.
3. `CommitRefusalBarkBinder.cs:125` **— bark shows** `UNSPECIFIED` **but the log line is blank.** When the abort code falls back, put the same fallback code in the `MessageLogLine` so bark and log agree.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #699)

(1) is deferred by design — #699 is a headless PR; Unity host wiring and Editor screenshots are explicitly out of scope. (2)/(3) only surface once a host renders barks; no live consumer yet.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Strip and bark render in the live commit UI via the existing presentation host; projection-only fence (`CommitStripProjectionFenceTests`) stays green; plugin DLL refreshed; Editor capture recorded.
* One denied order yields exactly one DROPPED bark (correlated `PolicyDenialRecord` + synthetic not-launched `EngagementRecord` coalesced); regression test.
* Fallback abort code (e.g. `UNSPECIFIED`) appears in both bark and log line; regression test.
* Façade remains authoritative; no `SimulationSession` / order-sink / `DelegationBridge` edits from presentation.

linear.title: Per-category message-log notification policy (log / pause / map balloon / drop to 1x)
linear.description:
## Problem

The message log has no per-category notification policy. In CMO, each message type (new contact, weapon launch, weapon endgame, unit lost, fuel, etc.) can be set to: show in the log, raise a pop-up that pauses the sim, show a balloon on the map at the subject, and drop time compression to 1x. Without this, a player running at high time compression can miss a hostile launch or a lost unit until well after it happens. Aegis has pause and acceleration (<issue id="33bfdfcc-aeed-49b3-b9a5-e2dd6df86193" label="DRG-14" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause" />) and a message log (<issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" />), but nothing links log categories to attention or time-control behavior.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual, Game Options → Message Log: per message type, "Show on Message Log", "Raise Pop-Up" (pauses the game), "Show Balloon" (on the map at the subject's location), and "Timescale X1" (drop from acceleration to 1x). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/>)
* CMO manual §3.1.7: the log is split into categories that can be minimized or emphasized, so routine messages don't bury critical ones. Hovering a message highlights its subject on the map. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* Player feedback asks for exactly this per-type control, including keeping time running while still being notified. [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/](<https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" /> covers click → unit deep-link, and <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> covers sourcing combat lines from CombatEvent. Neither covers category policy or time-control escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageCategoryPolicy` projection maps each message category to {Log, Pause, Balloon, DropToRealTime}. Defaults are data-driven, not hardcoded.
* When a matching message arrives, the projection emits an attention intent. Pause and 1x requests go through the existing command/time façade as player-visible requests. The projection never calls sim internals directly, and the change does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath or SimulationSession.
* The UI binds only to the projection. A settings panel edits the policy, and balloon markers anchor to the message subject.
* Replay is deterministic: under AttachReplayViewer, policy-driven pauses are suppressed or reported but never change the order log.
* Tests cover the default mapping, a user override, and the no-op under replay.

Source: Projects Manager web research 2026-10-07

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** message log [DRG-402](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402>) (landed <pull-request id="f6dd5ef2-b75d-43d3-9c4a-eae5f822ddf6" label="feat(delegation): source combat message lines from the combat event log (DRG-402)" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featdelegation-source-combat-message-lines-from-the-combat-event-log-5616d5bf6eaf" />; docs <pull-request id="c5584753-2067-429d-b057-f84062cc92f4" label="docs(c2): document MessageLogProjection combat-event-log fence (DRG-402)" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsc2-document-messagelogprojection-combat-event-log-fence-drg-402-d7ed3133e75b" />, <pull-request id="e5631854-4dd2-4e42-b6b7-56a62cc09b21" label="docs(c2): document MessageLogProjection live-view fog entry point (DRG-402)" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsc2-document-messagelogprojection-live-view-fog-entry-point-drg-402-f4aadc39cb48" />), deep-link [DRG-268](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268>) (hold:owner-go), pause/acceleration [DRG-14](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause>), raw view/export [DRG-412](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-412>). ADR-010 command façade.
* **Dependencies:** <issue id="f805cf5f-1b4f-409e-ba15-a1690895618a" label="DRG-412" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-412/message-log-raw-text-view-and-deterministic-after-action-text-export" /> must land first per its CMANO Surface stamp (2026-10-29); coordinate with [DRG-268](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link>) and [DRG-412](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-412/message-log-raw-text-view-and-deterministic-after-action-text-export>) on the category taxonomy.
* **Fences (from rubric H3/H5):** headless projection first; source-fence test (no UnityEngine/MonoBehaviour/ApplyOrder/DecisionLog write/SimulationSession/DelegationBridge refs); replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged, no ReplayGolden re-bless; any visible UI change gets a named [DRG-208](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208>) Play Mode walk item (human gate).

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

First-package priority. Own the shared category-policy/attention-intent implementation. <issue id="867f8b51-af1a-4320-8edf-95b1ac4c07cd" label="DRG-398" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-398/ops-01-time-compression-with-safe-stop-events" /> owns accelerated-time integration/proof; <issue id="e6b8236e-036b-44a4-a4cf-aad1142d7815" label="DRG-269" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-269/n-irq-01-pending-approval-interrupt-force-1-and-dlz-countdown" /> owns pending-approval/DLZ behavior; reuse a single policy/coordinator.

Additional AC:

* Source alerts from the permitted live view; hidden information must not leak through sound, balloon, count or pause.
* Process each event identity once across refresh/reopen; replay scrubbing produces no live command.
* Deterministic simultaneous-intent precedence, with Pause above DropTo1x; dismissing one alert does not clear another unresolved pause reason.
* Routine coalescing retains counts and never suppresses a newly actionable approval.
* Verify safe-stop timing against actual accelerated pipeline steps; next-frame visual notification alone is insufficient.
* Reuse MessageLogBridge.ProjectLive and inspect C2ClockCommand; keep policy projection free of simulation mutation.

Runtime remains Backlog pending fresh GitNexus impact and bounded file scope. The connected development laptop is offline.

linear.title: DRG-345 follow-up: [H4-CAPABILITY] add 'generic-only' Warning tier for Patrol/Strike on CLI simulate path
linear.description:
## Context

Deferred code-review finding on [PR #698](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/698>) (<issue id="044990c3-0fab-4227-988a-c3ca7af56e6f" label="DRG-345" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-345/h4-capability-expose-unsupported-mission-roles-before-export-and-play" /> disclose unexecuted mission roles before Export and Play). Related: <issue id="5f3fde68-82d5-4309-8b80-1254f1308065" label="DRG-346" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-346/h4-first-slice-map-edit-validate-save-export-play-using-existing" /> H4 first slice.

## Finding

`MissionRoleCapabilityManifest.cs:103` **labels Patrol/Strike as executed**, but `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` never passes missions to `BalticReplayHarness.Run`. On the CLI simulate path, Patrol/Strike missions are therefore effectively generic (units behave without mission-specific execution), so the manifest overstates execution.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #698)

The obvious fix — marking Patrol/Strike unexecuted at **Error** severity — would block Export of every Patrol/Strike scenario, which is worse than the current overstatement. The right fix needs a new intermediate tier, which is a contract change beyond #698's scope.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Manifest gains a **generic-only** tier evaluated per execution backend (CLI simulate vs session/Play), surfaced as a **Warning** finding with a stable code.
* Patrol/Strike on the CLI simulate path produce the generic-only Warning; Export and Play are **not** blocked; Tanker/AEW/EW unexecuted Errors unchanged.
* Disclosure text in validation UI/briefing states the role runs as generic behavior on that backend; UI does not invent sim authority.
* Deterministic role-policy fixtures + UI projection tests cover executed / generic-only / unexecuted; saving incomplete drafts still allowed.
* If `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` is later changed to pass missions, the tier flips to executed via the manifest (no hard-coded role lists in UI). ReplayGolden hash untouched.

Multiplayer, if chosen, lets commanders face each other on the same deterministic picture. ## 3. Detailed Rules — current repo state ### H4 — Scenario Editor Phase 2 GUI - The headless core is shipped: src/ProjectAegis.Data/Scenario/Authoring/ (ScenarioAuthoringSession, ScenarioEditCommandBus, ScenarioDocumentEditor, ScenarioUndoStackStore, MissionBoardQuery, EventStaticAnalyzer). - Headless presenters are ready to bind: src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Authoring/ (EditModeController, MapAuthoringSurface, LiveFindingsPresenter, MissionBoardPresenter, EventGraphPresenter). - Unity hosts exist: unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/ScenarioMapAuthoringWindow.cs and unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/ScenarioEditorShellHost.cs (undo/redo buttons, dirty label, Mission Board slot). - The only GUI scope boundary is P2.1 (production/scenario-editor-phase2-1-scope-boundary-2026-07-08.md). There is one group with one key, Map/App6FrameAtlas (unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Addressables/Map/App6AtlasAddressablesManifest.json, unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/App6AddressablesGroupSetup.cs, headless src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/App6AddressablesCatalog.cs). It is consumed by MapPlaceholderPanelHost with a Unicode fallback (S27-07). - The roadmap says "Addressables / remote content design undesigned". There is no content-pipeline ADR (ADR-001…026 on main; ADR-027 Unity-MCP is in open PR #679). - .claude/agents/unity-addressables-specialist.md still says Addressables 2.3.16, which has drifted from 2.9.1. - Blocking: the ADR does not exist, and the bulk scope (which content classes, local vs remote) is undefined. ### H6 — Save-Load / Multiplayer - There is no game-state save/load. SimulationSession (src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Orchestration/SimulationSession.cs) has Pause, Resume, SetTimeAccelerationFactor and Tick, but no save or restore. ReplayCheckpointStore records only simTick, worldHash, logFingerprint and lastSequenceId, which is verification data, not restorable state. - The GDD already describes the target: design/gdd/simulation-core-time.md edge case "Save/load restores simTick, scenarioSeed, RNG stream counters (checkpoint + log tail)". The determinism contract is in docs/engineering/determinism-and-replay.md. - Multiplayer is out of v1: design/gdd/game-concept.md, production/stage.txt, production/release/launch/faq-draft.md. Also: ReplayGolden 6/6 · Baltic v2 hash 17144800277401907079 · PlayModeSmoke ≥20/20 · DelegationBridge ZERO hotpath · CatalogWriteGate extend-only · presentation wall ADR-010 / 007 / 001 · Stage Release. ## 4. Formulas None defined in the current implementation. ## 5. Edge Cases — risks and hard-no exposure ### Top risks - H6 vs the DelegationBridge hotpath hard-no. Multiplayer order injection goes through DelegationBridge.TryEnqueueHumanOrder / TryIssuePlayerCommand, and the tick is DelegationBridge.Tick(ISimWorldSnapshot, IOrderSink). A full state snapshot would have to reach inside SimulationSession (a frozen hub). Only a replay-to-tick save driven through existing public APIs has a chance of being zero-touch. DRG-330 checks that. - H6 vs deterministic replay. Any change to order-log or checkpoint schema (ADR-003) or to tick order can move the Baltic hash. Re-blessing ReplayGolden silently is forbidden; a re-bless needs its own ADR. - H5 vs the presentation wall. Addressables APIs must stay in Unity presentation assemblies. ProjectAegis.Sim, ProjectAegis.Data and ProjectAegis.Delegation keep headless resolvers only. Sim-relevant data (catalog, scenario policy) must not load through Addressables, or the hash can drift. - H5 vs map hosts. The only Addressables consumer is MapPlaceholderPanelHost, and globe tiles live behind GlobeMapProductHost. Bulk loading needs a new loader seam, not growth in those hosts. - H4 vs CatalogWriteGate. Folding the WYSIWYG platform editor into H4 collides with ADR-011 (Excel-primary) and the extend-only gate. - Tracker drift resolved for planning. cmano-clone H4–H6 milestones now describe the September30 planning direction and retain implementation gates. linear.title: [H6] Product decision: save-load only vs multiplayer for H6
linear.description:
## Context

H6 bundles two things of very different size:

* **Save/load** is single-player and fits the deterministic core. The GDD already specifies it (`design/gdd/simulation-core-time.md`: "Save/load restores simTick, scenarioSeed, RNG stream counters (checkpoint + log tail)").
* **Multiplayer** is excluded from v1 in `design/gdd/game-concept.md` ("Out (v1): full multiplayer") and in `production/stage.txt`. The roadmap calls it "out of single-player deploy model". It would change the deploy model, store copy (`production/release/store/store-page-draft.md`: "Singleplayer focus"), and the `DelegationBridge` order-injection path.

This is an **owner decision**. It is not engineering work.

## Decision options

1. Save/load only, and multiplayer stays out of v1. This is the smallest ADR and the least bridge exposure.
2. Save/load now, with multiplayer as a separate later horizon (for example H9) behind its own ADR.
3. Save/load + multiplayer together. That needs a netcode model (deterministic lockstep vs server-authoritative), a v1 scope change, and store/FAQ changes.

## Questions the owner must answer

- [ ] Save/load: manual save slots, autosave, or both? Mid-engagement saves allowed?
- [ ] Must saves survive a build or catalog update, or only the same build and same catalog snapshot?
- [ ] Is multiplayer in or out of H6? If in: co-op or adversarial, LAN or online, turn/lockstep or real time?
- [ ] Is a `DelegationBridge` / `SimulationSession` **product waiver** acceptable, or must the design be zero-touch?

## Entry gate

This story **is** the "product confirmation" half of the H6 gate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The decision is recorded as a comment here and in the Notion H4–H6 intake page
- [ ] The H6 ADR story is updated with the chosen option
- [ ] If multiplayer is out, the H6 epic is renamed or scoped to save/load and the `cmano-clone` H6 milestone note is updated after GO

Surface: none (decision only)

## Start condition

**Nothing is started until the owner gives GO.** This issue stays in Backlog and no agent is dispatched.

2026-09-30 user authorized all review recommendations: use **save first / multiplayer separate and later** as the roadmap planning direction. Keep manual/autosave, retention, cross-build compatibility and architecture constraints as explicit decision questions. Record owner approval of the eventual product/ADR package separately; this planning update does not claim implementation or close the issue.

linear.title: [H6] Draft ADR: save/load + multiplayer vs DelegationBridge ZERO-touch constraint
linear.description:
## Context

* `production/agentic/local-cloud-agent-routing.md`: "Zero-touch: DelegationBridge hotpath / SimulationSession unless product waiver"

No game-state save/load exists today. `ReplayCheckpointStore` holds hashes only. `SimulationSession` is a frozen hub (`docs/architecture/adr-simulation-session-frozen-hub-spirit1-2026-06-20.md`).

## Scope of the ADR

Write a new ADR under `docs/architecture/` using the next free number. ADR-027 is taken by open PR <pull-request id="540d1213-7de1-4ff7-a462-c2a405c9d241" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#679" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsunity-record-unity-mcp-stack-choice-adr-027-and-fix-0860-version-176dd2257933" />, so check before numbering.

1. **Save model options**, compared:
   * (a) Replay-to-tick: persist scenario id + seed + catalog snapshot hash + human/player order log, then load by deterministic re-simulation
   * (b) Full state snapshot
   * (c) Hybrid: periodic state checkpoint + log tail, as the GDD `design/gdd/simulation-core-time.md` describes
2. **ZERO-touch analysis**: which option can run entirely *outside* `DelegationBridge.Tick` and the `SimulationSession` hotpath (for example, a new orchestration-level driver that replays orders through existing public APIs). Which one needs a product waiver, and exactly which methods it would touch.
3. **Determinism and ReplayGolden**: prove the Baltic v2 hash `17144800277401907079` and ReplayGolden 6/6 are unaffected, or state the re-bless plan under this ADR. **No silent re-bless.** Cover order-log schema impact (ADR-003) and the `SeededRng` / `SimWorldHash` contract (`docs/engineering/determinism-and-replay.md`).
4. **Multiplayer section**, scoped by the product decision (<issue id="bd666834-41d3-4329-b768-035ac588db6f" label="DRG-328" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-328/h6-product-decision-save-load-only-vs-multiplayer-for-h6" />): lockstep over the same order log vs server-authoritative, and why either touches `TryEnqueueHumanOrder` / `TryIssuePlayerCommand` (CMD-31/32/34 seams).
5. **Catalog**: saves pin `CatalogSnapshotHasher` output and never write through `CatalogWriteGate`.
6. **Presentation**: how Play Mode rebinds after a load without editing `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` / `GlobeMapProductHost` (ADR-010 / 007 / 001 presentation wall).

## Entry gate

This story **is** the ADR half of the H6 gate. The owner can draft it before the product decision; it becomes Accepted only after <issue id="bd666834-41d3-4329-b768-035ac588db6f" label="DRG-328" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-328/h6-product-decision-save-load-only-vs-multiplayer-for-h6" /> is decided.

linear.title: [H6] Read-only spike: replay-to-tick resume feasibility + mutable session-state inventory
linear.description:
## Context

A save model that keeps `DelegationBridge` and `SimulationSession` untouched depends on one thing: whether a session can be rebuilt by deterministically re-simulating `(scenario, seed, catalog snapshot, order log)` up to a tick through existing public APIs. The facts this rests on:

* `docs/engineering/determinism-and-replay.md`: `(scenario, seed)` gives an identical order log. `SeededRng` is a pure function of `(seed, domain, entityId, simTick, drawIndex)`.
* `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Replay/ReplayCheckpointStore.cs` and `ReplayCheckpoint`: hashes only, so they can verify a resume but cannot restore one.
* `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Baltic/BalticReplayHarness.cs`: an existing headless re-simulation driver.
* `SimulationSession` holds non-deterministic or UI-driven state that a save must capture: clock pause and acceleration (`SetTimeAccelerationFactor`), `WatchAttentionQueue`, `WatchAutoPauseGate`, direct-control state, and queued human orders.

## Task (read-only)

1. Inventory every piece of mutable session state that is **not** reproducible from `(scenario, seed, order log)`.
2. Estimate replay-to-tick cost for a long session. Use existing perf evidence such as `production/qa/swarm-a6-replay-performance-caps-2026-08-09.md` and batch-replay numbers.
3. List which existing public APIs a replay driver would call, and confirm none of them is a `DelegationBridge.Tick` / `SimulationSession` hotpath edit.
4. Write findings as input for the H6 ADR.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Brief written under `production/agentic/` (or a scratch doc linked here), with a verified/unverified split
- [ ] State inventory table: field, owner type, reproducible yes/no
- [ ] Clear feasible / not-feasible verdict for a zero-touch replay-to-tick save
- [ ] **Zero** edits to `src/`, `unity/`, `tests/regression/`

Surface: docs-only (`production/agentic/h6-save-model-spike-*.md`)

## Start condition

**The owner gave GO on 2026-09-27 for this docs-only, read-only lane** ("bring H4–H6 in scope ASAP"). It is running as cloud agent `bc-beb3774f-803c-5e68-856c-3e8a883cddd9`. The GO does not cover <issue id="bd666834-41d3-4329-b768-035ac588db6f" label="DRG-328" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-328/h6-product-decision-save-load-only-vs-multiplayer-for-h6" /> (product decision) or <issue id="21b86382-597f-4dfe-8495-168305a61fdb" label="DRG-329" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-329/h6-draft-adr-saveload-multiplayer-vs-delegationbridge-zero-touch" /> (ADR), which stay in Backlog.

## Consolidated source review — 2026-10-01

Reviewed PR <pull-request id="7930cbb8-8046-4506-af6a-423e211bb50c" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#685" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/drg-330-read-only-spike-for-replay-to-tick-saveload-feasibility-a300f31d551f" /> head e3054dfd against origin/main 1902dc12. Capture complete authoritative inputs, dual clock/cadence, catalog/sensor identity and checkpoint fingerprint; prove uninterrupted-vs-restored equivalence plus non-mutating incompatible/corrupt rejection. This supplies ADR-329/contract348 inputs. Save/resume first; multiplayer stays separate. No hotpath edits or owner acceptance. Keeps In Progress pending correction/proof.

linear.title: [H6-SAVE-SLICE] Prove deterministic same-build save and resume before multiplayer
linear.description:
Owner: drg amtd. Proposed RPL-29–31; blocked by save contract and H6 product/ADR/spike decisions. No sprint dates assigned.

Acceptance: continuous N+M-tick run equals N-tick save/restore plus M-tick run for world hash, order log sequence/content and replay fingerprint using same build/catalog/scenario/seed. Include pending engagements/orders/triggers and corrupt/incompatible payload fixtures; failed restore leaves original session unchanged. Save-before-multiplayer boundary is explicit. Runtime implementation follows approved contract and GitNexus impact analysis; DelegationBridge zero-touch invariant preserved.

## Save/resume delivery alignment — 2026-10-30

Follow [DRG-348's contract draft](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df81f59f6afed203c1d04f?pvs=204>) and the [command-experience delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). The user authorized proceeding with the recommendations; ADR-029 already supplies the accepted save direction. <issue id="d224a671-afb7-4ea8-bf7e-84279249c710" label="DRG-348" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-348/h6-save-contract-define-complete-same-buildcatalog-save-resume-state" /> remains incomplete and is still the implementation dependency. Existing dependency relations are retained.

Extend the proof matrix beyond final-world hashes: compare journal order/results, log sequence/content and replay fingerprints at restoration and future boundaries. Include at least three interruption points (before approval, with a delayed order, during engagement/resource change), accelerated clocks, same-tick inputs, traits/rebrief, control handoff, pending salvo overrides, and unknown/omitted journal commands. Validate build/catalog/scenario identity and full catalog coverage. Rejection, cancellation and failed writes must preserve the active session or previous save slot as applicable.

Restore into an isolated world/snapshot/order-sink/bridge candidate, verify replay, then swap consistently and expose the paused session. Share the existing stepper; do not fork RunCore or assume ReplayCheckpointStore can hydrate. Journal the new alert-policy/control/doctrine commands when introduced. Optional external-provider replay must use captured inputs rather than live calls.

No runtime implementation, tests, performance result, owner acceptance or protected-method waiver is claimed. Development laptop is offline; required GitNexus impact is unavailable. Keep Backlog until the contract and execution prerequisites are satisfied.

linear.title: [H5] Draft content-pipeline / Addressables ADR
linear.description:
## Context

The H5 entry gate is "Content pipeline ADR accepted". No such ADR exists (`docs/architecture/` holds ADR-001…026; ADR-027 is in open PR <pull-request id="540d1213-7de1-4ff7-a462-c2a405c9d241" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#679" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/docsunity-record-unity-mcp-stack-choice-adr-027-and-fix-0860-version-176dd2257933" />).

Addressables use today is a single atlas key, `Map/App6FrameAtlas`:

* `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Addressables/Map/App6AtlasAddressablesManifest.json`
* `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/App6AddressablesGroupSetup.cs`
* `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/App6AddressablesCatalog.cs`
* Consumed by `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` with a Unicode fallback (S27-07)

The package is `com.unity.addressables` 2.9.1. The roadmap (`docs/reports/future-sprint-roadmap-07142026.md`) lists "Addressables / remote content design undesigned".

## Scope of the ADR

Write a new ADR under `docs/architecture/` using the next free number.

1. **Content classes** in and out of Addressables:
   * Presentation art/USS/audio (`production/assets/*`, `design/assets/asset-manifest.md`)
   * APP-6 atlases
   * Globe/basemap tiles
   * Scenario packages (`AegisScenarioPackage`)
   * Catalog snapshots (`src/ProjectAegis.Data/Snapshots/`)

   Core sim DLLs are **out** (`.claude/agents/unity-addressables-specialist.md`).
2. **Presentation wall** (ADR-010 / 007 / 001): Addressables APIs only in Unity presentation assemblies. `ProjectAegis.Sim`, `ProjectAegis.Data` and `ProjectAegis.Delegation` keep headless resolvers like `App6AddressablesCatalog` and never reference `UnityEngine.AddressableAssets`.
3. **Determinism**: sim-relevant data (catalog, scenario policy) must reach the sim through existing Data loaders and hashes (`CatalogSnapshotHasher`, `UnifiedReleaseTrainManifest`), not through Addressables. State how the Baltic hash `17144800277401907079` stays preserved. **No silent ReplayGolden re-bless.**
4. **CatalogWriteGate**: Addressables never becomes a write path into the catalog.
5. **Host impact**: bulk loading must go through a new loader seam, not by growing `MapPlaceholderPanelHost` or `GlobeMapProductHost`. If it cannot, name the waiver.
6. **Local vs remote**: local-only for Release, or remote/CDN (Launch-adjacent, and H3 is not open).
7. Build and CI: headless CI cannot build Addressables content, so say what is verified headless and what needs a local Editor.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ADR file merged with Status Proposed, then Accepted by the owner (this closes the H5 gate)
- [ ] Content-class table with owner and loader for each class
- [ ] Hard-no impact stated per host, gate and golden
- [ ] First slice named, with a non-`TBD` Surface

Surface: `docs/architecture/adr-0NN-content-pipeline-addressables.md` (docs-only)

## Start condition

**Nothing is started until the owner gives GO for H5.** This issue stays in Backlog and no agent is dispatched.

2026-09-30 planning direction authorized by user: local presentation-only pilot first (<issue id="d37c71b0-abcf-43e4-844f-8f7b545a0ffd" label="DRG-347" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-347/h5-pilot-local-presentation-content-loading-with-deterministic-failure" />), with loading failure isolation and authoritative replay invariants. Inventory <issue id="e3383353-b551-45de-807d-60a52efe11ad" label="DRG-332" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-332/h5-content-inventory-classify-addressables-candidates-vs-sim-relevant" /> gates this ADR. Package/version and lifetime decision remain Proposed until reviewed; remote delivery/DLC/catalog behavior is excluded.

linear.title: Introduce typed mission-thread evidence and a unified evidence ledger
linear.description:
## Goal

Replace fragile, substring-oriented proof as the primary integration mechanism with versioned, typed mission-thread evidence correlated to replay, requirements, and CI results.

## Acceptance criteria

* Defines schema/versioning for relevant contact, authority, data-link, recommendation, engagement, and assessment facts.
* Correlates a scenario run with replay, oracle outcome, Buildkite evidence, and defect follow-up.
* Retains existing fingerprint checks during migration; no silent loss of fail-closed coverage.
* Keeps simulation facts authoritative and observable without duplicating tactical logic.

## Dependency

Requires the capability manifest.

## Revision-bound evidence extension — 2026-09-30

Owner: drg amtd. Requirement VER-07.3–6 (proposed). Every evidence row records requirement/AC ID, inspected and executed revision (and dirty-tree identity), scenario/seed/policy/catalog identity, command or harness, timestamp, artifact link, result and evidence kind (static inspection/headless/Editor capture/human acceptance). Keep declared floor separate from observed counts; historical results cannot satisfy a different revision. Missing, skipped or blocked evidence remains explicit. Owner signoff is a separate row with person/date/revision; technical success never infers acceptance.

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** parent epic [DRG-198](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-198>); blocks [DRG-202](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-202>). The 'capability manifest' dependency has no Linear issue.
* **Decision needed (CMANO):** the capability manifest it depends on is unticketed, and the evidence schema/version format is a design decision.

linear.description:
## Context

`docs/architecture/adr-017-editor-topology-client-vs-scenario-lab.md` is still **Proposed** (dated 2026-07-01). It proposes a headless-first shared core (`ProjectAegis.Data` + CLI/MCP, per ADR-010) with the in-client Unity editor as the v1 surface, and a Scenario Lab as an optional later front-end, never a fork.

It **blocks** any Scenario Lab epic until Accepted. The H4 scope boundary needs this answer to fix the GUI host.

3. If Accepted, the H4 scope boundary uses the in-client host for the first slice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ADR-017 status changed from Proposed, with the decision rationale
- [ ] The H4 scope boundary story cites the outcome
- [ ] Docs-only change. No code.

Surface: `docs/architecture/adr-017-editor-topology-client-vs-scenario-lab.md`

**Nothing is started until the owner gives GO for H4.** This issue stays in Backlog and no agent is dispatched. The ADR's own target date (2026-10-01) is informational only.

Horizon Definition Entry gate Linear epic

Multiplayer, if chosen, lets commanders face each other on the same deterministic picture. ## 3. Detailed Rules — current repo state ### H4 — Scenario Editor Phase 2 GUI - The headless core is shipped: src/ProjectAegis.Data/Scenario/Authoring/ (ScenarioAuthoringSession, ScenarioEditCommandBus, ScenarioDocumentEditor, ScenarioUndoStackStore, MissionBoardQuery, EventStaticAnalyzer). - Headless presenters are ready to bind: src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Authoring/ (EditModeController, MapAuthoringSurface, LiveFindingsPresenter, MissionBoardPresenter, EventGraphPresenter). - Unity hosts exist: unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/ScenarioMapAuthoringWindow.cs and unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/ScenarioEditorShellHost.cs (undo/redo buttons, dirty label, Mission Board slot). - The only GUI scope boundary is P2.1 (production/scenario-editor-phase2-1-scope-boundary-2026-07-08.md). Linear DRG-57 was canceled with its five scope questions unanswered. - Blocking: no product prioritization, no Phase 2 GUI scope boundary, and WYSIWYG platform editor in/out undecided. ### H5 — Content Pipeline / Addressables - com.unity.addressables 2.9.1 in unity/ProjectAegis/Packages/manifest.json. There is one group with one key, Map/App6FrameAtlas (unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Addressables/Map/App6AtlasAddressablesManifest.json, unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Editor/App6AddressablesGroupSetup.cs, headless src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/App6AddressablesCatalog.cs). It is consumed by MapPlaceholderPanelHost with a Unicode fallback (S27-07). - The roadmap says "Addressables / remote content design undesigned". There is no content-pipeline ADR (ADR-001…026 on main; ADR-027 Unity-MCP is in open PR #679). - .claude/agents/unity-addressables-specialist.md still says Addressables 2.3.16, which has drifted from 2.9.1. - Blocking: the ADR does not exist, and the bulk scope (which content classes, local vs remote) is undefined. ### H6 — Save-Load / Multiplayer - There is no game-state save/load. ReplayCheckpointStore records only simTick, worldHash, logFingerprint and lastSequenceId, which is verification data, not restorable state. - The GDD already describes the target: design/gdd/simulation-core-time.md edge case "Save/load restores simTick, scenarioSeed, RNG stream counters (checkpoint + log tail)". The determinism contract is in docs/engineering/determinism-and-replay.md. - Multiplayer is out of v1: design/gdd/game-concept.md, production/stage.txt, production/release/launch/faq-draft.md. MultiplayerManager.asset is only the Unity default. - ZERO-touch wording: AGENTS.md "DelegationBridge.cs — Zero-touch through Release v1 — no hotpath changes". production/agentic/local-cloud-agent-routing.md "Zero-touch: DelegationBridge hotpath / SimulationSession unless product waiver". - Blocking: no product confirmation (save-load only vs multiplayer), no ADR, and no waiver decision. ### Standing rules (unchanged) The suite floor follows production/test-floor.json (≥1638, 0 failed). Formulas None defined in the current implementation. ## 5. Edge Cases — risks and hard-no exposure ### Top risks - H6 vs the DelegationBridge hotpath hard-no. Multiplayer order injection goes through DelegationBridge.TryEnqueueHumanOrder / TryIssuePlayerCommand, and the tick is DelegationBridge.Tick(ISimWorldSnapshot, IOrderSink). A full state snapshot would have to reach inside SimulationSession (a frozen hub). Only a replay-to-tick save driven through existing public APIs has a chance of being zero-touch. DRG-330 checks that. - H6 vs deterministic replay. Any change to order-log or checkpoint schema (ADR-003) or to tick order can move the Baltic hash. Re-blessing ReplayGolden silently is forbidden; a re-bless needs its own ADR. - H5 vs the presentation wall. Addressables APIs must stay in Unity presentation assemblies. ProjectAegis.Sim, ProjectAegis.Data and ProjectAegis.Delegation keep headless resolvers only. Sim-relevant data (catalog, scenario policy) must not load through Addressables, or the hash can drift. - H5 vs map hosts. The only Addressables consumer is MapPlaceholderPanelHost, and globe tiles live behind GlobeMapProductHost. Bulk loading needs a new loader seam, not growth in those hosts. - H4 vs CatalogWriteGate. Folding the WYSIWYG platform editor into H4 collides with ADR-011 (Excel-primary) and the extend-only gate. - Tracker drift resolved for planning. cmano-clone H4–H6 milestones now describe the September30 planning direction and retain implementation gates. CMD-31 / 32 / 34 None None High — commands persisted / networked

linear.title: DRG-345 follow-up: [H4-CAPABILITY] add 'generic-only' Warning tier for Patrol/Strike on CLI simulate path
linear.description:
## Context

Deferred code-review finding on [PR #698](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/698>) (<issue id="044990c3-0fab-4227-988a-c3ca7af56e6f" label="DRG-345" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-345/h4-capability-expose-unsupported-mission-roles-before-export-and-play" /> disclose unexecuted mission roles before Export and Play). Related: <issue id="5f3fde68-82d5-4309-8b80-1254f1308065" label="DRG-346" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-346/h4-first-slice-map-edit-validate-save-export-play-using-existing" /> H4 first slice.

## Finding

`MissionRoleCapabilityManifest.cs:103` **labels Patrol/Strike as executed**, but `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` never passes missions to `BalticReplayHarness.Run`. On the CLI simulate path, Patrol/Strike missions are therefore effectively generic (units behave without mission-specific execution), so the manifest overstates execution.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #698)

The obvious fix — marking Patrol/Strike unexecuted at **Error** severity — would block Export of every Patrol/Strike scenario, which is worse than the current overstatement. The right fix needs a new intermediate tier, which is a contract change beyond #698's scope.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Manifest gains a **generic-only** tier evaluated per execution backend (CLI simulate vs session/Play), surfaced as a **Warning** finding with a stable code.
* Patrol/Strike on the CLI simulate path produce the generic-only Warning; Export and Play are **not** blocked; Tanker/AEW/EW unexecuted Errors unchanged.
* Disclosure text in validation UI/briefing states the role runs as generic behavior on that backend; UI does not invent sim authority.
* Deterministic role-policy fixtures + UI projection tests cover executed / generic-only / unexecuted; saving incomplete drafts still allowed.
* If `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` is later changed to pass missions, the tier flips to executed via the manifest (no hard-coded role lists in UI). ReplayGolden hash untouched.
